## Company Overview

**Dalvi Consultancy** is a full-service software development agency and digital consultancy based in Pune, India.

### What We Are
- Software Development Company
- AI Solutions Provider
- Web & Mobile App Developer
- Digital Agency & Tech Consultancy
- Automation Specialists

### What We Build
- Custom Software Solutions
- AI & Machine Learning Applications
- Websites & Web Applications
- Mobile Apps (iOS, Android, Cross-platform)
- SaaS Platforms & Enterprise Software
- E-commerce Stores
- Workflow Automation Systems

### Mission
Transform complex business challenges into elegant, scalable digital solutions through custom engineering.

### Service Areas
T10-703, Unit B, Blueridge Township, Phase-1, Hinjewadi, Pune - 410057, Maharashtra, India. Serving clients globally.


---

## Services

### 1. Web & App Engineering
Full-stack development using modern frameworks. We build progressive web apps, SaaS platforms, e-commerce stores, and custom business tools.

**Technologies:** Next.js 14, React 18, TypeScript, Node.js, Express, Firebase (Auth, Firestore, Functions, Hosting), Tailwind CSS, Prisma, PostgreSQL, MongoDB.

**Deliverables:** Responsive web applications, admin dashboards, customer portals, API development.

### 2. AI Chatbots
Intelligent conversational agents for customer support, lead qualification, and sales automation. Integrates with WhatsApp, Telegram, and web interfaces.

**Technologies:** Dialogflow, OpenAI GPT, Google Genkit, LangChain, Python, Node.js.

**Capabilities:** 24/7 automated support, multi-language, CRM integration, escalation to human agents.

### 3. Workflow Automation
Eliminate manual tasks with custom automation pipelines. Connect disparate systems, automate data entry, and streamline operations.

**Technologies:** n8n, Zapier, Make (Integromat), custom Python scripts, Google Apps Script.

**Use Cases:** Invoice processing, lead nurturing sequences, inventory sync, reporting dashboards.

### 4. Creative Design
UI/UX design, brand identity, marketing collateral, and professional imagery that resonates with target audiences.

**Deliverables:** Figma prototypes, design systems, logos, social media assets, pitch decks.

---

## Products (Internal)

### RTO Buddy
**Category:** SaaS / Business Application
**URL:** https://rtobuddy.dalvigroup.co.in
**Description:** Comprehensive RTO management solution for vehicle registration agents. Digitizes compliance workflows, automates form filling, provides real-time application tracking, and manages documentation.

**Key Features:**
- Automated form pre-filling from vehicle data
- Real-time status tracking dashboard
- Document upload and management
- Multi-agent support with role-based access

### SMPG (Social Media Post Generator)
**Category:** Web Tool
**URL:** https://smpg.dalvigroup.co.in
**Description:** Browser-based tool for creating branded social media posts. Supports custom backgrounds, text overlays, profile integration, and export to PNG/JPEG.

**Key Features:**
- Dynamic background colors and gradients
- Username and verification badge support
- Client-side processing (no server upload)
- Preset color palettes

### VPTC (Virtual Public Transport Card)
**Category:** System / Proof of Concept
**Description:** Digital ticketing system for public transport. Replaces physical smart cards with QR-based mobile passes.

**Key Features:**
- QR code generation and validation
- Balance top-up via UPI/cards
- Trip history and analytics

### Dirt Shack
**Category:** E-commerce
**Description:** Premium off-road gear and accessories store. Built on modern e-commerce stack with inventory management.

### Buon Cibo

## FAQ

### What services does Dalvi Consultancy offer?
We provide custom software development, AI chatbot integration, web application engineering using Next.js and React, and workflow automation for businesses in Pune and globally.

### Where is Dalvi Consultancy located?
We are based in Pune, Maharashtra, India, serving clients in tech hubs like Hinjewadi, Magarpatta, Wakad, and Aundh, as well as remote clients worldwide.

### What technologies do you specialize in?
Our core stack includes Next.js, React, TypeScript, Node.js, Firebase, Python, n8n, and Tailwind CSS. We also work with WordPress, PHP, and mobile development tools.

### How can I start a project with you?
Email us at support@dalvigroup.co.in to discuss your project.

### Do you offer maintenance and support?
Yes, we provide ongoing maintenance, feature updates, and technical support packages for all projects we deliver.
